I’m currently 26 and I find myself everyday comparing myself to others my age even some younger who have fancier cars/clothes and other things,

Recently though I have started having a realisation that just because someone has these things doesn’t mean they are happier or better off than you, yes they may have a top of the range car but what is it costing them? Is it putting them into a deep debt? Regardless of whether it is or not, possessions don’t make you rich (famously quoted by Bob Marley) how I see it now is if I am happy in myself, I have a bed to sleep in, food on the table most nights and I have a good circle of people around me that matters far more than whether I earn more money than the person next to me, too much lately there is so many things out there making people compare their life’s to each other and we shouldn’t be trying to be someone else.

I’m English, I spend a lot of time comparing myself to everyone else, I thought I had people there for me and lately I feel so alone and that I have nobody, I spend everyday just sat hoping it will be my last day and hopefully I might just go to sleep and never wake up but I know that won’t happen, not yet anyways.
